text: P6f.12 and the SharedKernel facade decision are now closed, so API sequencing is complete. Cross-version +test passed 542 tests on Scala 3.3.8 and 542 on 3.8.4; +doc completed. This is not release evidence because the machine only has Homebrew JDK 25 and no JDK 17 at /opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@17 or via /usr/libexec/java_home. Cutting/tagging/publishing 0.1.0 is also an explicit external release decision and was not performed under the broad repair request. MiMa remains honestly disabled until that baseline exists.
